notes.title: 4rth demo update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44552970/91f7815ddd95f87678634905b54d2793534c93e7.gif"]

Wow, it's been a whole year that the demo hasn't been updated ! 



Firstly, I wanted to aplologize for this lack of communication. I had to take a break from gamedev to focus on working on myself, but now I am fully commited to working on FLAW.

 Here's what's been added/changed :   
Features :
 Enemies can now take cover and/or dive if they're being shot at.


A lot more but that's for the rest of the game, like drivable vehicles and new enemies.



improvments:
 The HUD and every texts are smaller.



Fixes :[olist]
 Fixed a ladder issue.


 Quicksave / Quickload didn't seemed to save some animation, that's fixed.  



If you drop a weapon, the slots are rearranged accordingly. 


serveral minor bugs.


A lot more but that's for the rest of the game.
[/olist]


Balance :
 I've placed some weapons and removed some others. 

 Thank you for your support, I'll have some big news soon.

  Dev out !

notes.title: 3rd spring demo update
notes.content:
https://res.cloudinary.com/dvasphgnv/image/upload/v1713014414/FLAW/Updates/stjjoepfpubtrh50hshj.gif

It's been a while since the last update, I've reworked a ton of things and started working on another level (which won't be included on the demo though).

Here's what's been added/changed :


Features :

 Added a togglable 60 fps limit.
 Added a togglable sprint button.
 Added a togglable crouch button.
 Added a main menu to the ingame menu.


improvments:

 Reduced the loading time when skipping the intro.
 Removed the intro for now (which has to do with the saving system).
 Reduced the loading time for each level (when from 10+ sec to around 3 sec on my end).
 Ennemies now stops from running if they see the player.
 added a better safety gun pickup animation.
 Options are now regrouped in two screens.
 Melee now hits farther.


Fixes :
[olist]
 Some NPCs clipping through a wall on the first jail level.
 Quicksave / Quickload didn't seemed to be working properly, it's fixed.
 Enemies were invincibles after some time.
 You could get stuck in a wall on the 2nd jail level in the shack at the flying encounter.
 When close to an enemy your bullets could phase through.
 Sprint could not be bound.
[/olist]

Balance :

 Harpoon thrower does more damage.


Please do not take my lack of contribution on the forum section for a lack of interest on yout feedbacks, I am reading them and taking notes on what could be improved. Thank you again for your support ! 

Dev out !

notes.title: 2nd spring demo update
notes.content:
Here what I've worked on for this update :

Fixes :
[olist]
 Some NPCs were moving without their appropriate animation.
 The ennemies weren't selecting their next destination right..
 Optimized the shotgun to avoid framerate drops.
 Better pooling for decals.
 Better pooling for projectiles.
 Optimized ragdolls, gibs, debris, explosions by pooling them.
[/olist]

Balance :

 Tweaked all of the weapons bullet speed.



Features :

 Allies can now dodge bullets by groveling.


Feel free to suggest what could be improved on twitter. Thank you again for your support ! I've found a renewed motivation to work on the game theses pasts months and it feels great. I'm planning a lots of things for this piece of media.

Dev out !

notes.title: First spring demo update
notes.content:
I've started to fix the bugs that have been reported on the demo. Here what should be fixed for now :

Fixes :

[olist]
 Some survivors not dying when asked to.
 The player suddenly getting up when crawling into a vent.
 Lack of a death trigger that resulted in an infinite fall.
 Fixed some crates that were not spawning their loot.
 Several optimization fixes.
 Fixed the speed of how texts are displayed.
[/olist]

Balance :


 Grenades and some enemies now do less damages.
 Less probability for the enemies to throw a grenade.
 Enemies are now more prone to be staggered.



Feature :


 You can now skip the intro.
 Added a Quicksave/Quickload option (F5/F7, binds can be changed in the option).
 Added an antosave feature.
 Added color to some text to make some tutorials more obvious.
 Now the game saves the state of most of the animated objects (ie: you can save while on a lift or a moving platform).
 The SMG wielding enemies shooting animation are more obvious, they really aim at you.


Thank you for playing the game. There is still a lot of work for me to do but seeing how much people liked the demo (even though there's a lot a bugs) motivates me to get something really great out.
